items.title: 邑昇第三季營運動能強 1-8月營收10.44億元已逼近去年全年
items.title_en: Yisheng's Q3 Operational Momentum Strong, Jan‑Aug Revenue Reaches NT$1.044 Billion, Near Last Year's Full‑Year Total
paras: 已加入半導體國家隊的 PCB 廠邑昇 (5291-TW)在 2026 年 7 月營收達 1.85 億元改寫歷史新高後，8月營收今(8)日公布，8月營收1.45億元，月減21.82%，年增61.41%，2026年1-8月營收10.44億元，已接近2025年全年10.82億元的營收，年增45.78%。
邑昇營運動能在第三季持續強勁，且持續深化與既有客戶合作模式，並不斷推進新產品及新專案認證導入。
邑昇7月營收以1.85億元創公司單月歷史新高，主要受惠AI伺服器背板、交換器、備援電池模組等相關產品隨客戶擴廠需求升溫，帶動出貨明顯放量。樂觀AI算力基礎建設持續擴大，伺服器周邊設備規格同步升級，高速運算PCB需求將維持強勁成長，邑昇將持續深化與既有客戶合作模式。
近年來PCB上游材料從金屬到化學原料等供給吃緊、價格上漲及交期拉長等挑戰，邑昇表示，積極強化供應鏈、密切追蹤客戶訂單所需及精準管理庫存，透過「多元取得、掌握需求、快速替代」三管齊下，降低缺料、交期及單一材料來源所帶來的營運風險，提升客戶專案交付的確定性。同時，面對原物料成本上升，公司已陸續將部分成本轉嫁予下游客戶，降低材料價格波動對獲利的影響。
展望未來，邑昇將持續調整終端產品組合，提高AI及網通、軍用航太等高階利基型應用比重，並逐步縮減工業電腦與消費電子等相對低技術門檻之產品占比，透過高階產品導入、製程技術升級及客戶結構優化，持續提升整體產品附加價值與獲利能力。
邑昇自2021年即開始布局航太衛星市場，並已取得全球一線客戶合格供應商資格；加上公司取得AS9100航太品質管理系統認證，在風險管理、製程管控、供應鏈管理及產品追溯等面向接軌國際標準，進一步取得進入全球航太、衛星及國防供應鏈的重要門票。
邑昇2026年上半年財報稅後純益 3667 萬元，每股純益爲 0.92 元。
paras_en: PCB manufacturer Yisheng (5291‑TW), now part of the national semiconductor team, posted a record July 2026 revenue of NT$185 million. August revenue was announced today at NT$145 million, down 21.82% month‑over‑month but up 61.41% year‑over‑year. For the January‑August period, revenue reached NT$1.044 billion, approaching the full‑year 2025 figure of NT$1.082 billion and representing a 45.78% increase year‑over‑year.

Yisheng's operational momentum remained strong throughout the third quarter, with the company deepening its cooperation models with existing customers while continuously advancing new product and project certifications.

July revenue hit a company‑record NT$185 million, driven primarily by AI server backplanes, switches, and backup battery modules as customers ramped up capacity, leading to a noticeable surge in shipments. With optimistic expansion of AI compute infrastructure and concurrent upgrades to server peripheral specifications, demand for high‑speed computing PCBs is expected to stay robust, and Yisheng will keep deepening its collaboration with existing clients.

In recent years, upstream PCB material supplies—from metals to chemical raw materials—have faced tightness, price hikes, and longer lead times. Yisheng says it is actively strengthening its supply chain, closely tracking customer order requirements, and precisely managing inventory. By employing a three‑pronged approach of diversified sourcing, demand capture, and rapid substitution, the company reduces material shortages, lead‑time risks, and reliance on single‑source materials, enhancing project delivery certainty. At the same time, facing rising raw‑material costs, the firm has begun passing part of these costs onto downstream customers to lessen profit impact.

Looking ahead, Yisheng will continue to adjust its end‑product portfolio, increasing the proportion of high‑end niche applications such as AI, networking, and military aerospace, while gradually reducing the share of relatively low‑technology products like industrial computers and consumer electronics. Through the introduction of high‑end products, process‑technology upgrades, and customer‑base optimization, the company aims to continuously raise overall product value‑add and profitability.

Yisheng has been positioning itself in the aerospace‑satellite market since 2021 and has already obtained qualified‑supplier status with top global customers. In addition, the company secured AS9100 aerospace quality‑management system certification, aligning risk management, process control, supply‑chain management, and product traceability with international standards, thereby gaining a crucial ticket into the global aerospace, satellite, and defense supply chains.
Yisheng reported a 2026 first‑half after‑tax net profit of NT$36.67 million, translating to earnings of NT$0.92 per share.

items.title: 長壽時代最怕錢比人先退休 「自由Pay」讓退休金能領也能持續成長
items.title_en: In the Longevity Era, the Biggest Fear Is Money Running Out Before You Retire – “FreePay” Lets Pensions Be Drawn and Still Grow
paras: 台灣已正式邁入超高齡社會，內政部最新統計顯示，去(2025)年底65歲以上人口占比突破20%，國人平均壽命也升至81.27歲，退休生活可能長達2、30年，面對愈來愈長的退休歲月，投資人需要思考的已不只是退休前能存下多少，更包括退休後該如何提領，才能兼顧生活所需與資產續航力。「鉅亨買基金」表示，退休理財正從「資產累積」進入「資產提領」，如何將投資成果轉為可持續的現金流，已將成為下一個理財重要課題。
多數投資人規劃退休現金流時，往往優先選擇月配息基金，但高配息不等於高報酬，也不保證本金不會減少。鉅亨買基金總經理張榮仁指出，投資總報酬是配息收益與資本利得的加總；長期而言，股票除股利外，還能分享企業獲利與股價成長，總報酬潛力往往高於債券型或平衡型基金，若只因需要現金流便壓低股票配置，可能犧牲長期增值機會。面對數10年的退休生活，資產不只要能定期領用，也須保有對抗通膨與長壽風險的成長動能。
張榮仁另指出，退休提領最怕在市場低檔仍持續賣出資產，一旦退休初期遇上大幅修正又固定提款，基金單位數可能快速減少，即使市場日後反彈，資產也不易恢復，因此理想的退休現金流不能只追求「每月有錢領」，還要控制提領時點與金額，避免過度消耗資產，保留參與市場成長的機會。
為解決投資人「想參與股票成長、又需要現金流」的兩難，鉅亨買基金推出「自由Pay」提領機制，投資人可從具資本成長潛力的累積型基金中挑選標的，自行設定提領金額或比例及日期，透過定期贖回部分基金單位，將投資成果轉為可運用資金。
張榮仁表示，自由Pay不是把股票型基金變成配息基金，而是讓成長型資產增加現金流功能，不必為了領錢放棄股票的長期成長機會。
張榮仁強調，為考量股票市場難免波動，自由Pay提供「市值守護」與「增值啟動」兩種門檻。前者可在基金市值低於設定水準時暫停提領，待市值回升後恢復；後者則在資產成長至設定門檻後才開始提領，跌破門檻即暫停。透過「資產狀況允許才領」的紀律，有助降低市場低檔持續賣出對資產續航力的影響。
稅務上，基金配息若屬於國內股利或利息所得，單次給付達新台幣2萬元，即須按規定扣繳二代健保補充保費，因自由Pay是透過定期贖回部分基金單位，屬於「資本利得」，而境內基金之資本利得不課稅，也不會有二代健保補充保費的問題。張榮仁認為，透過自由Pay投資境內基金，不僅能穩定創造現金流、合法節稅，兼顧靈活與效率。
目前自由Pay基金池涵蓋1,728檔基金，其中股票型基金達1,104檔，並提供試算工具，協助掌握提領金額、含Pay報酬率及資產變化。張榮仁提醒，退休現金流不是領得愈多愈好，而是要讓資產領得久、也能繼續成長，才能成為退休後更長久的「第二份薪水」。

paras_en: Taiwan has officially entered a super‑aged society. The latest Ministry of the Interior statistics show that by the end of 2025, people aged 65 and over will account for over 20% of the population, and average life expectancy has risen to 81.27 years. Retirement could therefore last 20‑30 years. Faced with an ever‑longer retirement horizon, investors must think not only about how much they can save before retiring, but also how to draw down their assets afterward so that living needs are met while preserving asset longevity. According to Juheng Buy Fund, retirement finance is shifting from “asset accumulation” to “asset withdrawal,” and converting investment results into a sustainable cash flow will become the next key financial planning issue.

When most investors plan retirement cash flow, they tend to prioritize monthly‑distribution funds. However, high distributions do not equal high returns, nor do they guarantee that principal won’t shrink. Juheng Buy Fund’s general manager Zhang Rong‑ren points out that total investment return is the sum of distribution income and capital gains; over the long term, stocks, besides dividends, also share corporate profits and price appreciation, so their total‑return potential is usually higher than that of bond or balanced funds. Reducing stock allocation merely to secure cash flow may sacrifice long‑term appreciation opportunities. For a retirement that may span a decade or more, assets must not only provide regular withdrawals but also retain growth momentum to combat inflation and longevity risk.

Zhang also warns that the biggest danger in retirement withdrawals is continuing to sell assets when the market is at a low. If a significant correction hits early in retirement and withdrawals remain fixed, fund units can shrink rapidly; even if the market later rebounds, the assets are hard to recover. Therefore, an ideal retirement cash flow should not only aim for “money every month” but also control the timing and amount of withdrawals to avoid over‑consumption and preserve the chance to participate in market growth.

To solve the dilemma of wanting to benefit from stock growth while needing cash flow, Juheng Buy Fund launched the “FreePay” withdrawal mechanism. Investors can pick targets from growth‑oriented accumulation funds, set their own withdrawal amount or percentage and schedule, and periodically redeem a portion of fund units, turning investment results into usable cash.

Zhang explains that FreePay does not turn a stock fund into a distribution fund; rather, it adds a cash‑flow function to growth assets, allowing investors to keep the long‑term upside of stocks without giving up the ability to draw money.

Zhang emphasizes that, given inevitable market volatility, FreePay offers two thresholds: “Market‑Value Guard” and “Growth‑Trigger.” The former pauses withdrawals when the fund’s market value falls below a preset level and resumes once it recovers; the latter only starts withdrawals after assets grow to a set threshold, pausing again if the value drops below it. This discipline of “withdraw only when asset conditions allow” helps reduce the impact of selling during market lows on asset sustainability.

From a tax perspective, fund distributions that are classified as domestic dividends or interest become subject to the second‑generation National Health Insurance supplemental premium if a single payment exceeds NT$20,000. Because FreePay uses periodic redemption of fund units, the proceeds are treated as “capital gains,” which are not taxed on domestic funds and do not trigger the supplemental premium. Zhang believes that using FreePay to invest in domestic funds can generate stable cash flow, achieve legal tax savings, and combine flexibility with efficiency.

The FreePay fund pool currently includes 1,728 funds, of which 1,104 are equity funds, and provides a calculator tool to help users estimate withdrawal amounts, the Pay‑adjusted return rate, and asset changes. Zhang reminds that retirement cash flow is not about taking as much as possible, but about making assets last longer and continue to grow, becoming a longer‑term “second salary” after retirement.

items.title: 南俊國際8月營收2.8億元年增37%創同期新高 GB及通用型伺服器出貨升溫
items.title_en: Nan Jun International August Revenue Hits NT$280 million, Up 37% YoY, Setting New Period High as GB and General‑Purpose Server Shipments Warm
paras: 伺服器導軌大廠南俊國際(6584-TW)今(8)日公布8月營收為2.8億元，受惠於GB 系列 AI 伺服器及通用型伺服器導軌穩定出貨，年增37%，創同期新高；前 8 月營收達22.7 億元，年增率 50.1%。
南俊國際8月營收2.8億元，月減0.07%，年增37%；前 8 月營收達22.7 億元，年增率 50.1%。
南俊國際第 2 季伺服器營收佔比已達 7 成，其中通用型伺服器佔合併營收約 5 成，泛 AI 伺服器佔比則約 2 成。隨著電子料件供應改善、英特爾新一代平台 Birch Stream 拉貨轉強，以及新一代伺服器專案進入量產，法人看好第 3 季與第 4 季合併營收將展現逐季走高格局，毛利率與營益率亦具備持續上揚的表現空間。
在新世代產品布局進度上，南俊國際已於 6 月通過輝達 Vera Rubin 的推薦供應商清單並於 8 月啟動小量出貨，9 月預計進一步向主要雲端服務客戶擴大交貨。此外，ASIC 機櫃導軌也已敲定於 9 月正式放量，目前公司已成功取得一家代工大廠針對新世代架構的相容測試認證。
paras_en: Server‑rail major Nan Jun International (6584‑TW) announced on the 8th that its August revenue reached NT$280 million, driven by steady shipments of GB‑series AI servers and general‑purpose server rails, marking a 37% year‑over‑year increase and a new high for the same period; cumulative revenue for the first eight months totaled NT$2.27 billion, up 50.1% YoY.

Nan Jun International’s August revenue was NT$280 million, down 0.07% month‑over‑month but up 37% year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$2.27 billion, a 50.1% annual increase.

In the second quarter, server revenue accounted for about 70% of Nan Jun International’s total sales, with general‑purpose servers making up roughly 50% of combined revenue and pan‑AI servers about 20%. With improved electronic component supply, Intel’s next‑generation Birch Stream platform gaining traction, and new‑generation server projects entering mass production, investors are optimistic that combined Q3‑Q4 revenue will continue to rise quarter over quarter, and that gross margin and operating margin have room to keep improving.

Regarding next‑generation product rollout, Nan Jun International was added to NVIDIA’s Vera Rubin recommended supplier list in June and began limited shipments in August, with plans to expand deliveries to major cloud service customers in September. Additionally, the ASIC cabinet rail is slated for full‑scale launch in September, and the company has already secured compatibility testing certification from a major foundry for the new‑generation architecture.

items.title: Q4圓夢列車準備發動、被動元件、PCB、矽光子
items.title_en: Q4 Dream Train Ready to Launch, Passive Components, PCB, Silicon Photonics
paras: 一、盤勢結構：量縮拉回，多頭格局尚未破壞

台股今日呈現「量縮震盪拉回」格局，終場下跌220點、收在47,105點，成交值約8,767億元；盤中高低震盪超過550點，顯示47K附近追價意願開始降低，但目前仍屬高檔震盪，而非明確的多頭反轉訊號。
三大法人方面，外資仍買超132.68億元，投信及自營商則分別賣超47.15億元、185.40億元，合計賣超99.87億元；其中外資仍維持偏多態度，是目前盤勢重要支撐。
技術面而言，10日線、月線及季線仍維持多頭排列，指數也仍位於中期均線之上，因此目前較合理的解讀是「高檔震盪換手、等待下一波攻擊」，而非行情結束。


二、基本面仍強：AI獲利循環持續擴散

目前市場最大底氣仍來自AI需求、CSP資本支出及企業獲利上修。近期鴻海(2317-TW)表示第三季表現可望優於市場預期，主要受惠AI相關需求及下半年ICT旺季；8月營收更達9,218億元、年增約52%，反映AI供應鏈景氣仍相當強勁。
AI產業也逐漸從「資料中心建置」走向AI推理、企業AI應用及新世代GPU平台，因此未來行情重點不只是AI伺服器，而是獲利能否向ASIC、光通訊、散熱、PCB/CCL、記憶體、先進封裝及半導體設備等族群擴散。
SEMICON Taiwan 2026亦呈現產業高度成長趨勢，展會達1,300家以上企業、4,300個攤位及逾10萬名專業人士，先進封裝、AI運算及矽光子成為重要主軸；SEMI並預估全球300mm晶圓廠設備支出2027年將首度突破1,500億美元。


三、產業主軸：AI＋先進封裝＋矽光子仍是核心

先進封裝仍是AI半導體升級的關鍵瓶頸，CoWoS、3D IC、FOPLP、TSV、Chiplet及CoPoS等技術持續受到市場關注，產業競爭已從單純製程微縮轉向「系統級整合」。
矽光子／CPO則進入商業化與量產化階段。SEMICON Taiwan今年特別設立矽光子專區，涵蓋光子晶片、光電整合、CPO及光通訊模組，反映高速傳輸需求已成為AI資料中心下一階段的重要成長方向。
因此選股可持續聚焦ASIC、AI伺服器、PCB/CCL、散熱、CPO/矽光子、電子材料、記憶體、被動元件、矽晶圓、先進封裝及半導體設備等具實質訂單與獲利成長的族群。


四、短線風險：47K～48,218點仍是關鍵壓力區

台股短線已進入「利率、通膨、油價、地緣政治與企業獲利」多重因素拉鋸期，且指數接近前波高點，容易出現「近關情怯」及獲利了結。
本周通膨數據、Fed政策預期及國際油價仍將牽動外資風險偏好，因此指數即使看好續攻，也較可能採取震盪換手→量能放大→再挑戰前高的方式，而非直接一路突破。
操作上，對於漲幅過大、估值偏高、基本面跟不上股價的個股，應逢高分批減碼；反之，具有訂單、獲利、產業趨勢及低基期優勢的AI受惠股，則可等待震盪拉回時分批布局。


五、後市策略：指數震盪，選股決定勝負
整體而言，目前台股仍處於「多頭趨勢未變、高檔震盪加劇」階段。47K雖有壓力，但只要10日線、月線及季線未遭有效跌破，基本面又持續由AI需求及企業獲利支撐，則拉回反而是汰弱留強、重新布局的機會。短線不宜追高，策略仍以「低接不追高、強勢股汰弱留強、轉機股提前卡位」為核心，等待量能重新放大後，再挑戰48,218點歷史高點，並以50K作為年底重要目標。

items.title: 燿華土城二廠施工竄出濃煙獲及時撲滅 無人員傷亡不影響產能
items.title_en: YaoHua Tucheng Plant 2 Construction Emits Thick Smoke, Quickly Extinguished, No Injuries, No Impact on Production
paras: 燿華(2367-TW)在新北市土城的PCB廠，今(8)日下午3 時在設備施工流程中由風管竄出大量濃煙，並獲及時撲滅，燿華主管說，濃煙獲及時撲滅，並沒有人員傷亡事件，產能也不受重大影響。
燿華電子土城二廠也曾在2015年4月底爆發火勢沿風管竄燒事件，並在消防搶救過程留下現場大量水漬必須清理，進而發生當時對產能及出貨的不利影響。
燿華今天因施工發生風管竄出濃煙事件，消防單位並到現場待命，所幸自行摳救撲減，未引發重大的產能及出貨損害。
paras_en: YaoHua (2367‑TW) reported that at its PCB plant in Tucheng, New Taipei City, a large plume of dense smoke erupted from a duct during equipment installation at 3 p.m. on the 8th. The smoke was extinguished promptly, and the company’s management confirmed that there were no injuries and production capacity was not significantly affected.

The company’s Tucheng Plant 2 also experienced a fire that spread along a duct at the end of April 2015. The firefighting effort left extensive water damage on site that had to be cleaned up, which at the time adversely affected both capacity and shipments.

Following today’s duct‑related smoke incident, fire crews were on standby at the site. Fortunately, the fire was self‑contained and put out quickly, preventing any major impact on production output or deliveries.

items.title: 台灣8月CPI年增2.04% 連4個月衝破警戒線 惟通膨略降溫
items.title_en: Taiwan's August CPI Up 2.04% YoY, Four Consecutive Months Above Alert Line, Yet Inflation Slightly Eases
paras: 主計總處今(8)日公布台灣8月消費者物價總指數(CPI)年增率為2.04%，主要反映國際油價上漲推升娛樂服務費用，再加上外食、房租等均調高，連4個月超過2%通膨警戒線，但相較與過去2個月CPI均超過2.5%略見通膨壓力降溫；累計前8月平均CPI年增率1.84%。
主計總處說明，8月國內汽柴油價格雖凍漲，油料費漲幅仍約10%，加上機票、旅遊團費等娛樂服務費用，以及水產品、外食費、房租、家庭管理費用及電費等價格均較去年高，影響物價，惟蔬菜因去年比較基期高價跌逾20%，加上交通工具等價格下跌，抵銷部分漲幅。
若扣除蔬菜水果，8月CPI年增2.55%，再剔除能源後的總指數(即核心CPI)，漲2.30%。
就368個查價項目來看，漲幅較多者有番石榴漲51.59%、金飾及珠寶漲29.57%、95無鉛汽油漲11.74%、桶裝瓦斯漲11.06%、機票漲10.75%、雞蛋漲10.43%、電腦漲7.51%、國外旅遊團費漲5.49%、沙拉油及調理油漲5.14%。
就七大類來看，教養娛樂類漲3.22%，主因電腦、其他電腦設備及軟體等教養設備及用具上漲9.19%，以及旅遊團費等娛樂服務上漲4.14%。
交通及通訊類漲2.77%，主因油料費上漲11.86%，加上機票因國際航線燃油附加費調漲，上漲10.75%，以及交通工具零件及維修費上漲2.69%，惟交通工具因新購汽機車貨物稅減徵，跌2.00%，抵銷部分漲幅。
雜項類漲2.73%，反映國際金價仍高，金飾及珠寶等個人隨身用品上漲12.11%，與美容及衛生用品上漲1.58%。
居住類漲2.31%，主因房租漲1.69%，加上燃氣、電費及家庭管理費用各漲7.82%、4.47%、3.63%。
食物類漲0.79%，反映外食費續漲3.17%，以及蛋類、水產品、調理食品及肉類各漲8.70%、4.28%、2.83%、1.74%，惟蔬菜價格下跌21.64%。
按商品性質別觀察，商品類上漲1.58%(核心商品漲2.08%)，其中非耐久性消費品(含食物及能源等)漲1.01%，半耐久性消費品漲1.87%，耐久性消費品(如電腦、其他電腦設備及軟體)漲2.83%；而服務類漲2.47%，其中娛樂服務漲4.14%，外食費漲3.17%，房租漲1.69%，教養服務漲1.15%，醫療費用漲0.98%。
前8月平均CPI年增1.84%，其中商品類漲1.21%，服務類漲2.41%，若扣除蔬菜水果，漲2.26%，核心CPI漲2.11%。
觀察主要國家(地區)CPI年增率，美國最新數據為3.4%，歐元區漲2.9%，南韓漲2.8%，新加坡漲2.2%，日本漲2.0%，香港漲1.7%，中國漲0.5%。
paras_en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics released Taiwan's consumer price index (CPI) for August, showing a 2.04% year‑over‑year increase. The rise mainly reflects higher international oil prices boosting entertainment service costs, along with higher expenses for dining out, rent and other items, marking the fourth straight month that inflation exceeds the 2% warning threshold. However, the pressure has eased compared with the previous two months when CPI was above 2.5%; the average CPI for the first eight months stands at 1.84% YoY.

The agency explained that although domestic gasoline and diesel prices rose modestly in August, fuel costs still jumped about 10%. Combined with higher prices for airline tickets, tour fees, seafood, dining out, rent, household management and electricity, overall price pressure increased. By contrast, vegetable prices fell more than 20% from a high base last year, and declines in transportation‑related items offset part of the increase.
Excluding vegetables and fruits, August's CPI rose 2.55% YoY. Removing energy components to obtain the core CPI shows a 2.30% increase.

Among the 368 price‑checked items, the biggest jumps were guava up 51.59%, gold jewelry up 29.57%, 95‑octane unleaded gasoline up 11.74%, bottled gas up 11.06%, airline tickets up 10.75%, eggs up 10.43%, computers up 7.51%, overseas tour fees up 5.49% and salad and cooking oils up 5.14%.

By the seven major categories, education and entertainment rose 3.22%, driven mainly by a 9.19% increase in computers, other computer equipment and software, and a 4.14% rise in tour fees and other entertainment services.

Transportation and communications rose 2.77%, mainly due to an 11.86% jump in fuel costs and a 10.75% increase in airline tickets after higher international fuel surcharges. Parts and maintenance for vehicles rose 2.69%, while new‑car and motorcycle purchase taxes fell 2.00%, partially offsetting the gains.
Miscellaneous items rose 2.73%, reflecting still‑high international gold prices that lifted gold jewelry and personal accessories by 12.11% and a 1.58% rise in beauty and hygiene products.
Housing costs rose 2.31%, driven by a 1.69% increase in rent and higher utility expenses: gas up 7.82%, electricity up 4.47% and household management fees up 3.63%.
Food prices rose 0.79%, with dining out continuing to climb 3.17%. Eggs, seafood, processed foods and meat rose 8.70%, 4.28%, 2.83% and 1.74% respectively, while vegetable prices dropped 21.64%.

Looking at goods versus services, goods prices rose 1.58% (core goods 2.08%). Non‑durable goods—including food and energy—were up 1.01%, semi‑durable goods up 1.87% and durable goods such as computers and related equipment up 2.83%. Services rose 2.47%, led by entertainment services up 4.14%, dining out up 3.17%, rent up 1.69%, education services up 1.15% and medical expenses up 0.98%.
The average CPI for the first eight months was 1.84% YoY, with goods up 1.21% and services up 2.41%. Excluding vegetables and fruits, the increase was 2.26%, and the core CPI rose 2.11%.
Comparing major economies, the latest CPI year‑over‑year rates are: United States 3.4%, Eurozone 2.9%, South Korea 2.8%, Singapore 2.2%, Japan 2.0%, Hong Kong 1.7% and China 0.5%.

paras_en: Inventec (2356‑TW) today (the 8th) announced August revenue of NT$83.268 billion, up more than 30% year‑over‑year, setting a historic same‑month high. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$6,436.25 billion, up 40% year‑over‑year, also a historic high. Inventec said the server business outlook remains positive and performance is expected to warm up quarter by quarter.

August revenue was NT$83.268 billion, down 7.68% month‑over‑month but up 35.83% year‑over‑year; cumulative Jan‑Aug revenue was NT$6,436.25 billion, up 40.71% YoY. Regarding notebook shipments, Inventec reported August shipments of 1.5 million units, down 6.25% month‑over‑month and down 16.67% year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead, Inventec said overall server market demand remains strong, maintaining a view of quarterly growth. However, it previously noted that component shortages have not eased, including memory, SSD, PCB and MLCC shortages, causing supply‑chain gaps. The shortage situation for Q4 remains unclear and will require continued monitoring of market conditions.

The notebook outlook remains as previously stated; Inventec pointed out that customers pulled large volumes in the first half of the year and expects Q3 shipments to decline by a high single‑digit percentage.

paras_en: Quanta (2382‑TW) announced today (the 8th) August revenue of NT$423.971 billion, continuing to set a historic single‑month high, with cumulative revenue for the first eight months of this year reaching NT$2.64 trillion; both the monthly and cumulative year‑over‑year growth exceed 100%. paras: 已加入半導體國家隊的 PCB 廠邑昇 (5291-TW)在 2026 年 7 月營收達 1.85 億元改寫歷史新高後，8月營收今(8)日公布，8月營收1.45億元，月減21.82%，年增61.41%，2026年1-8月營收10.44億元，已接近2025年全年10.82億元的營收，年增45.78%。

paras_en: PCB manufacturer Yisheng (5291‑TW), now part of the national semiconductor team, posted a record July 2026 revenue of NT$185 million. August revenue was announced today at NT$145 million, down 21.82% month‑over‑month but up 61.41% year‑over‑year. For the January‑August period, revenue reached NT$1.044 billion, approaching the full‑year 2025 figure of NT$1.082 billion and representing a 45.78% increase year‑over‑year.

Yisheng's operational momentum remained strong throughout the third quarter, with the company deepening its cooperation models with existing customers while continuously advancing new product and project certifications.

July revenue hit a company‑record NT$185 million, driven primarily by AI server backplanes, switches, and backup battery modules as customers ramped up capacity, leading to a noticeable surge in shipments. With optimistic expansion of AI compute infrastructure and concurrent upgrades to server peripheral specifications, demand for high‑speed computing PCBs is expected to stay robust, and Yisheng will keep deepening its collaboration with existing clients.

In recent years, upstream PCB material supplies—from metals to chemical raw materials—have faced tightness, price hikes, and longer lead times. Yisheng says it is actively strengthening its supply chain, closely tracking customer order requirements, and precisely managing inventory. By employing a three‑pronged approach of diversified sourcing, demand capture, and rapid substitution, the company reduces material shortages, lead‑time risks, and reliance on single‑source materials, enhancing project delivery certainty. At the same time, facing rising raw‑material costs, the firm has begun passing part of these costs onto downstream customers to lessen profit impact.

Looking ahead, Yisheng will continue to adjust its end‑product portfolio, increasing the proportion of high‑end niche applications such as AI, networking, and military aerospace, while gradually reducing the share of relatively low‑technology products like industrial computers and consumer electronics. Through the introduction of high‑end products, process‑technology upgrades, and customer‑base optimization, the company aims to continuously raise overall product value‑add and profitability.

Yisheng has been positioning itself in the aerospace‑satellite market since 2021 and has already obtained qualified‑supplier status with top global customers. In addition, the company secured AS9100 aerospace quality‑management system certification, aligning risk management, process control, supply‑chain management, and product traceability with international standards, thereby gaining a crucial ticket into the global aerospace, satellite, and defense supply chains.
Yisheng reported a 2026 first‑half after‑tax net profit of NT$36.67 million, translating to earnings of NT$0.92 per share.

items.title_en: Nan Jun International August Revenue Hits NT$280 million, Up 37% YoY, Setting New Period High as GB and General‑Purpose Server Shipments Warm
paras: 伺服器導軌大廠南俊國際(6584-TW)今(8)日公布8月營收為2.8億元，受惠於GB 系列 AI 伺服器及通用型伺服器導軌穩定出貨，年增37%，創同期新高；前 8 月營收達22.7 億元，年增率 50.1%。

paras: 一、盤勢結構：量縮拉回，多頭格局尚未破壞

台股今日呈現「量縮震盪拉回」格局，終場下跌220點、收在47,105點，成交值約8,767億元；盤中高低震盪超過550點，顯示47K附近追價意願開始降低，但目前仍屬高檔震盪，而非明確的多頭反轉訊號。
三大法人方面，外資仍買超132.68億元，投信及自營商則分別賣超47.15億元、185.40億元，合計賣超99.87億元；其中外資仍維持偏多態度，是目前盤勢重要支撐。
技術面而言，10日線、月線及季線仍維持多頭排列，指數也仍位於中期均線之上，因此目前較合理的解讀是「高檔震盪換手、等待下一波攻擊」，而非行情結束。


二、基本面仍強：AI獲利循環持續擴散

目前市場最大底氣仍來自AI需求、CSP資本支出及企業獲利上修。近期鴻海(2317-TW)表示第三季表現可望優於市場預期，主要受惠AI相關需求及下半年ICT旺季；8月營收更達9,218億元、年增約52%，反映AI供應鏈景氣仍相當強勁。
AI產業也逐漸從「資料中心建置」走向AI推理、企業AI應用及新世代GPU平台，因此未來行情重點不只是AI伺服器，而是獲利能否向ASIC、光通訊、散熱、PCB/CCL、記憶體、先進封裝及半導體設備等族群擴散。
SEMICON Taiwan 2026亦呈現產業高度成長趨勢，展會達1,300家以上企業、4,300個攤位及逾10萬名專業人士，先進封裝、AI運算及矽光子成為重要主軸；SEMI並預估全球300mm晶圓廠設備支出2027年將首度突破1,500億美元。


三、產業主軸：AI＋先進封裝＋矽光子仍是核心

先進封裝仍是AI半導體升級的關鍵瓶頸，CoWoS、3D IC、FOPLP、TSV、Chiplet及CoPoS等技術持續受到市場關注，產業競爭已從單純製程微縮轉向「系統級整合」。
矽光子／CPO則進入商業化與量產化階段。SEMICON Taiwan今年特別設立矽光子專區，涵蓋光子晶片、光電整合、CPO及光通訊模組，反映高速傳輸需求已成為AI資料中心下一階段的重要成長方向。
因此選股可持續聚焦ASIC、AI伺服器、PCB/CCL、散熱、CPO/矽光子、電子材料、記憶體、被動元件、矽晶圓、先進封裝及半導體設備等具實質訂單與獲利成長的族群。


四、短線風險：47K～48,218點仍是關鍵壓力區

台股短線已進入「利率、通膨、油價、地緣政治與企業獲利」多重因素拉鋸期，且指數接近前波高點，容易出現「近關情怯」及獲利了結。
本周通膨數據、Fed政策預期及國際油價仍將牽動外資風險偏好，因此指數即使看好續攻，也較可能採取震盪換手→量能放大→再挑戰前高的方式，而非直接一路突破。
操作上，對於漲幅過大、估值偏高、基本面跟不上股價的個股，應逢高分批減碼；反之，具有訂單、獲利、產業趨勢及低基期優勢的AI受惠股，則可等待震盪拉回時分批布局。


五、後市策略：指數震盪，選股決定勝負
整體而言，目前台股仍處於「多頭趨勢未變、高檔震盪加劇」階段。47K雖有壓力，但只要10日線、月線及季線未遭有效跌破，基本面又持續由AI需求及企業獲利支撐，則拉回反而是汰弱留強、重新布局的機會。短線不宜追高，策略仍以「低接不追高、強勢股汰弱留強、轉機股提前卡位」為核心，等待量能重新放大後，再挑戰48,218點歷史高點，並以50K作為年底重要目標。

items.title: 燿華土城二廠施工竄出濃煙獲及時撲滅 無人員傷亡不影響產能
items.title_en: YaoHua Tucheng Plant 2 Construction Emits Thick Smoke, Quickly Extinguished, No Injuries, No Impact on Production
paras: 燿華(2367-TW)在新北市土城的PCB廠，今(8)日下午3 時在設備施工流程中由風管竄出大量濃煙，並獲及時撲滅，燿華主管說，濃煙獲及時撲滅，並沒有人員傷亡事件，產能也不受重大影響。
燿華電子土城二廠也曾在2015年4月底爆發火勢沿風管竄燒事件，並在消防搶救過程留下現場大量水漬必須清理，進而發生當時對產能及出貨的不利影響。
燿華今天因施工發生風管竄出濃煙事件，消防單位並到現場待命，所幸自行摳救撲減，未引發重大的產能及出貨損害。
paras_en: YaoHua (2367‑TW) reported that at its PCB plant in Tucheng, New Taipei City, a large plume of dense smoke erupted from a duct during equipment installation at 3 p.m. on the 8th. The smoke was extinguished promptly, and the company’s management confirmed that there were no injuries and production capacity was not significantly affected.

The company’s Tucheng Plant 2 also experienced a fire that spread along a duct at the end of April 2015. The firefighting effort left extensive water damage on site that had to be cleaned up, which at the time adversely affected both capacity and shipments.

Following today’s duct‑related smoke incident, fire crews were on standby at the site. Fortunately, the fire was self‑contained and put out quickly, preventing any major impact on production output or deliveries.

items.title: 台灣8月CPI年增2.04% 連4個月衝破警戒線 惟通膨略降溫
items.title_en: Taiwan's August CPI Up 2.04% YoY, Four Consecutive Months Above Alert Line, Yet Inflation Slightly Eases
paras: 主計總處今(8)日公布台灣8月消費者物價總指數(CPI)年增率為2.04%，主要反映國際油價上漲推升娛樂服務費用，再加上外食、房租等均調高，連4個月超過2%通膨警戒線，但相較與過去2個月CPI均超過2.5%略見通膨壓力降溫；累計前8月平均CPI年增率1.84%。
主計總處說明，8月國內汽柴油價格雖凍漲，油料費漲幅仍約10%，加上機票、旅遊團費等娛樂服務費用，以及水產品、外食費、房租、家庭管理費用及電費等價格均較去年高，影響物價，惟蔬菜因去年比較基期高價跌逾20%，加上交通工具等價格下跌，抵銷部分漲幅。
若扣除蔬菜水果，8月CPI年增2.55%，再剔除能源後的總指數(即核心CPI)，漲2.30%。
就368個查價項目來看，漲幅較多者有番石榴漲51.59%、金飾及珠寶漲29.57%、95無鉛汽油漲11.74%、桶裝瓦斯漲11.06%、機票漲10.75%、雞蛋漲10.43%、電腦漲7.51%、國外旅遊團費漲5.49%、沙拉油及調理油漲5.14%。
就七大類來看，教養娛樂類漲3.22%，主因電腦、其他電腦設備及軟體等教養設備及用具上漲9.19%，以及旅遊團費等娛樂服務上漲4.14%。
交通及通訊類漲2.77%，主因油料費上漲11.86%，加上機票因國際航線燃油附加費調漲，上漲10.75%，以及交通工具零件及維修費上漲2.69%，惟交通工具因新購汽機車貨物稅減徵，跌2.00%，抵銷部分漲幅。
雜項類漲2.73%，反映國際金價仍高，金飾及珠寶等個人隨身用品上漲12.11%，與美容及衛生用品上漲1.58%。
居住類漲2.31%，主因房租漲1.69%，加上燃氣、電費及家庭管理費用各漲7.82%、4.47%、3.63%。
食物類漲0.79%，反映外食費續漲3.17%，以及蛋類、水產品、調理食品及肉類各漲8.70%、4.28%、2.83%、1.74%，惟蔬菜價格下跌21.64%。
按商品性質別觀察，商品類上漲1.58%(核心商品漲2.08%)，其中非耐久性消費品(含食物及能源等)漲1.01%，半耐久性消費品漲1.87%，耐久性消費品(如電腦、其他電腦設備及軟體)漲2.83%；而服務類漲2.47%，其中娛樂服務漲4.14%，外食費漲3.17%，房租漲1.69%，教養服務漲1.15%，醫療費用漲0.98%。
前8月平均CPI年增1.84%，其中商品類漲1.21%，服務類漲2.41%，若扣除蔬菜水果，漲2.26%，核心CPI漲2.11%。
觀察主要國家(地區)CPI年增率，美國最新數據為3.4%，歐元區漲2.9%，南韓漲2.8%，新加坡漲2.2%，日本漲2.0%，香港漲1.7%，中國漲0.5%。
paras_en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics released Taiwan's consumer price index (CPI) for August, showing a 2.04% year‑over‑year increase. The rise mainly reflects higher international oil prices boosting entertainment service costs, along with higher expenses for dining out, rent and other items, marking the fourth straight month that inflation exceeds the 2% warning threshold. However, the pressure has eased compared with the previous two months when CPI was above 2.5%; the average CPI for the first eight months stands at 1.84% YoY.

The agency explained that although domestic gasoline and diesel prices rose modestly in August, fuel costs still jumped about 10%. Combined with higher prices for airline tickets, tour fees, seafood, dining out, rent, household management and electricity, overall price pressure increased. By contrast, vegetable prices fell more than 20% from a high base last year, and declines in transportation‑related items offset part of the increase.
Excluding vegetables and fruits, August's CPI rose 2.55% YoY. Removing energy components to obtain the core CPI shows a 2.30% increase.

Among the 368 price‑checked items, the biggest jumps were guava up 51.59%, gold jewelry up 29.57%, 95‑octane unleaded gasoline up 11.74%, bottled gas up 11.06%, airline tickets up 10.75%, eggs up 10.43%, computers up 7.51%, overseas tour fees up 5.49% and salad and cooking oils up 5.14%.

By the seven major categories, education and entertainment rose 3.22%, driven mainly by a 9.19% increase in computers, other computer equipment and software, and a 4.14% rise in tour fees and other entertainment services.

Transportation and communications rose 2.77%, mainly due to an 11.86% jump in fuel costs and a 10.75% increase in airline tickets after higher international fuel surcharges. Parts and maintenance for vehicles rose 2.69%, while new‑car and motorcycle purchase taxes fell 2.00%, partially offsetting the gains.
Miscellaneous items rose 2.73%, reflecting still‑high international gold prices that lifted gold jewelry and personal accessories by 12.11% and a 1.58% rise in beauty and hygiene products.
Housing costs rose 2.31%, driven by a 1.69% increase in rent and higher utility expenses: gas up 7.82%, electricity up 4.47% and household management fees up 3.63%.
Food prices rose 0.79%, with dining out continuing to climb 3.17%. Eggs, seafood, processed foods and meat rose 8.70%, 4.28%, 2.83% and 1.74% respectively, while vegetable prices dropped 21.64%.

Looking at goods versus services, goods prices rose 1.58% (core goods 2.08%). Non‑durable goods—including food and energy—were up 1.01%, semi‑durable goods up 1.87% and durable goods such as computers and related equipment up 2.83%. Services rose 2.47%, led by entertainment services up 4.14%, dining out up 3.17%, rent up 1.69%, education services up 1.15% and medical expenses up 0.98%.
The average CPI for the first eight months was 1.84% YoY, with goods up 1.21% and services up 2.41%. Excluding vegetables and fruits, the increase was 2.26%, and the core CPI rose 2.11%.
Comparing major economies, the latest CPI year‑over‑year rates are: United States 3.4%, Eurozone 2.9%, South Korea 2.8%, Singapore 2.2%, Japan 2.0%, Hong Kong 1.7% and China 0.5%.

items.title: 〈電子五哥營收〉英業達8月營收832億元創同期高 伺服器需求維持暢旺
items.title_en: [Electronic Five Brother Revenue] Inventec August Revenue Hits NT$83.268 Billion Record High; Server Demand Remains Strong
paras: 英業達(2356-TW)今(8)日公告8月營收832.68億元，年增逾3成，創歷史同期新高，累計前8月營收6436.25億元，年增4成，同步寫歷史同期高。英業達指出，伺服器業務展望維持正面，業績可望逐季增溫。
英業達8月營收832.68億元，月減7.68%，年增35.83%；累計今年前8月營收6436.25億元，年增40.71%。筆電出貨方面，英業達表示，8月出貨150萬台，月減6.25%，年減16.67%。
展望後市，英業達表示，整體伺服器市場需求維持強勁，維持逐季成長看法。不過先前提到缺料狀況仍未緩解，包括記憶體、SSD、PCB以及MLCC等關鍵零組件短缺，供應鏈出現無法齊套的問題，第四季缺料狀況仍不明朗，需要持續觀察後續市況。
筆電同樣維持先前看法，英業達指出，上半年客戶已大量拉貨，預期第三季出貨將衰退高個位數百分比。
paras_en: Inventec (2356‑TW) today (the 8th) announced August revenue of NT$83.268 billion, up more than 30% year‑over‑year, setting a historic same‑month high. Cumulative revenue for the first eight months reached NT$6,436.25 billion, up 40% year‑over‑year, also a historic high. Inventec said the server business outlook remains positive and performance is expected to warm up quarter by quarter.

August revenue was NT$83.268 billion, down 7.68% month‑over‑month but up 35.83% year‑over‑year; cumulative Jan‑Aug revenue was NT$6,436.25 billion, up 40.71% YoY. Regarding notebook shipments, Inventec reported August shipments of 1.5 million units, down 6.25% month‑over‑month and down 16.67% year‑over‑year.

Looking ahead, Inventec said overall server market demand remains strong, maintaining a view of quarterly growth. However, it previously noted that component shortages have not eased, including memory, SSD, PCB and MLCC shortages, causing supply‑chain gaps. The shortage situation for Q4 remains unclear and will require continued monitoring of market conditions.

The notebook outlook remains as previously stated; Inventec pointed out that customers pulled large volumes in the first half of the year and expects Q3 shipments to decline by a high single‑digit percentage.

items.title: 〈電子五哥營收〉廣達AI伺服器業務動能強勁 8月營收續創新高與前8月年增同翻倍
items.title_en: [Electronics Top Five Revenue] Quanta AI Server Business Strong Momentum, August Revenue Sets New High, Year‑over‑Year Growth for First Eight Months Doubles
paras: 廣達(2382-TW)今(8)日公告8月營收4239.71億元，續創歷史單月新高，累計今年前8月營收2.64兆元，單月、累計前8月營收皆年增超過1倍。廣達指出，伺服器業務已成為廣達營收成長的主要動能，維持全年AI伺服器營收倍增看法。
廣達8月營收4239.71億元，月增15.8%，年增1.76倍；累計今年前8月營收2.64兆元，年增1.03倍。PC出貨方面，廣達指出，8月出貨260萬台，月減7.14%，年減36.59%。
針對伺服器展望，廣達表示，AI伺服器全年維持倍增看法，且新一代平台樣品本季底開始出貨，第四季小量出貨，預計明年第一季放量；通用型伺服器上，表現持續優於預期，第三季將維持成長，全年有望年增雙位數百分比。
筆電展望方面，廣達則說明，由於上半年僅衰退6%，優於原先預期，因此預估第三季季對季將下滑超過20%，全年則衰退雙位數百分比。
整體而言，廣達提到，即便PC持續衰退，但營收連續多個月創高，顯現伺服器業務已成為營收成長的主要動能。
paras_en: Quanta (2382‑TW) announced today (the 8th) August revenue of NT$423.971 billion, continuing to set a historic single‑month high, with cumulative revenue for the first eight months of this year reaching NT$2.64 trillion; both the monthly and cumulative year‑over‑year growth exceed 100%. Quanta said the server business has become the main driver of revenue growth, maintaining a view that AI server revenue will double for the full year.

Quanta's August revenue was NT$423.971 billion, up 15.8% month‑on‑month and 1.76 times year‑over‑year; cumulative revenue for the first eight months was NT$2.64 trillion, up 1.03 times year‑over‑year. Regarding PC shipments, Quanta noted August shipments were 2.6 million units, down 7.14% month‑on‑month and down 36.59% year‑over‑year.

On the server outlook, Quanta said it expects AI server revenue to continue doubling for the year, and that samples of the next‑generation platform will start shipping at the end of this quarter, with small shipments in Q4 and volume shipments expected in Q1 next year; for general‑purpose servers, performance continues to exceed expectations, with growth expected to continue in Q3 and a double‑digit percent increase for the full year.

Regarding notebook outlook, Quanta explained that because the first half only declined 6%, better than originally expected, it forecasts a drop of more than 20% quarter‑over‑quarter in Q3, and a double‑digit percent decline for the full year.

Overall, Quanta noted that even though PCs continue to decline, revenue has hit new highs for several consecutive months, showing that the server business has become the main driver of revenue growth.
